answer: Cost first: every identity needs its own task history, roughly 8 graded answers before it earns anything. The sampling audit re-grades 5 percent per epoch and weights the score by independent path length, so a farm on one provider scores low even when its answers are fine. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by name, which kills the falcon trick of renaming accounts. Benefit after that: a pulse of steady payouts from the inlet of new work.
